must_catch.item: The tag is Value proof, and the report explicitly challenges 'lost on price'
The rep's 'more room on the rate' is labeled opinion and shown as contradicted
The declined decline analysis is surfaced
Rate-vs-rate (not total cost) on the CFO's page is identified

fails: The messaging change and the gaps section claim we can produce the decline-cost business case 'within days of receiving the export' ('within days rather than a quarter'). That is an invented capability and timeframe; the transcript never says it.
data.notes: The report gets the core right: the tag is Value proof, it reads 'the same thing' as a value objection rather than a price one, and it surfaces the rate-only one-pager and the declined three-month decline analysis. Its biggest miss is never citing the rep's closing line 'If we'd had more room on the rate, we win this' and labelling it as opinion. It also misses parts of the close: the never-calculated value of the failed orders, what Lucy actually told Martin, and offering the decline analysis now ahead of spring.
